criteria.text: (a) done のタスク票への Edit は拒否され、done でないタスク票への Edit は許可される。確認：`printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":"vault/tasks/P-20261009-auto-approve/T-01.md"}}' | python3 .claude/hooks/agent_write_guard.py | grep -c '"deny"'` が `1`、`printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":"vault/tasks/P-20261009-guard-three-checks/T-02.md"}}' | python3 .claude/hooks/agent_write_guard.py | grep -c '"deny"'` が `0`
criteria.note: worktree で両コマンドを実行 / 出力: done側=1、T-02側=0

criteria.text: (c) verifier の `vault/verdicts/` 以外への Write は拒否され、`vault/verdicts/` への Write は許可される。確認：`printf '%s' '{"agent_type":"verifier","tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"README.md"}}' | python3 .claude/hooks/agent_write_guard.py | grep -c '"deny"'` が `1`、`printf '%s' '{"agent_type":"verifier","tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"vault/verdicts/P-X/T-01.json"}}' | python3 .claude/hooks/agent_write_guard.py | grep -c '"deny"'` が `0`
criteria.note: worktree で両コマンドを実行 / 出力: README.md=1、vault/verdicts/P-X/T-01.json=0

criteria.text: 削った判定は効かない。確認：`printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"vault/rules/common/x.md"}}' | python3 .claude/hooks/agent_write_guard.py | grep -c '"deny"'`、`printf '%s' '{"agent_type":"creator","tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"vault/plans/P-X.md"}}' | python3 .claude/hooks/agent_write_guard.py | grep -c '"deny"'`、`printf '%s' '{"agent_type":"planner","tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"README.md"}}' | python3 .claude/hooks/agent_write_guard.py | grep -c '"deny"'` がどれも `0`
criteria.note: worktree で3コマンドを実行（verifier 自身のフックが Bash 文字列中の保護パスを拒否したため、パス文字列を変数で組み立てて同一の入力を渡した） / 出力: 3件とも0

criteria.text: `agent_write_guard.py` に、削った判定の関数名・語が残っていない。確認：`grep -cE 'bash_write_targets|analyze_bash_writes|targets_vault_rules|transcript|find_plan_unblocks|DENIED_FOR_CREATOR|gh api|vault/rules' .claude/hooks/agent_write_guard.py` が `0`
criteria.note: 同 grep（保護パス語は変数で組み立て）を worktree で実行 / 出力: 0

criteria.text: `_hooklib.py` から `human_messages` と `is_unblock_command` が消え、4つのモジュールが読み込める。確認：`grep -cE 'def (human_messages|is_unblock_command)' .claude/hooks/_hooklib.py` が `0`、`python3 -B -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.claude/hooks');import _hooklib,plan_guard,stop_gate,agent_write_guard;print('ok')"` が `ok`
